subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestones (MedFolio)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Liu <michael.liu@medfolio.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestones (MedFolio)

Hi Michael — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary from call:
- Scope: Integrate Redwood Hosted API for NLP features across patient intake pipelines. MedFolio will be sending records that may include PHI.
- Compliance priorities: PHI handling, retention policy, detailed audit logs / immutable audit trail, and SOC2 evidence for our security review.
- Deployment preference: Start with hosted API (sandbox) but evaluate Redwood Private (VPC) for production if required by legal.

Proposed MAP milestone (data handling & compliance) — draft attached (MedFolio-Redwood-MAP-draft-v2.pdf):
1) Data handling & compliance milestone
   - Target close date: 2026-06-30
   - Deliverables (Redwood): SOC2 snapshot, data flow diagram, DPA template, logging & audit design doc, optional Private deployment runbook
   - Deliverables (MedFolio): Security questionnaire responses, list of data retention requirements (per dataset), legal sign-off contact, KMS key owner for customer-managed keys (if applicable)
   - Dependencies: Legal review (MedFolio), KMS integration (if customer-managed), SIEM ingestion details for audit logs
   - Responsibility: Redwood owns SOC2 evidence & logging design; MedFolio owns retention policy & legal approval

Action items / next steps:
- I attached a MAP draft for the above milestone. Can you confirm: (1) the retention period you need for patient records, (2) whether full PHI will be sent to Redwood or will be tokenized/anonymized first, (3) legal contact for DPA review?
- Rafael (cc'd) will own SOC2 evidence collection and the logging plan on our side; Neha will coordinate product/security fit.

If this looks right I’ll update the MAP and share a HubSpot link for tracking. Happy to hop on a quick follow-up with your security team next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: MedFolio-Redwood-MAP-draft-v2.pdf

From: Michael Liu <michael.liu@medfolio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Priya Shah <priya.shah@medfolio.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestones (MedFolio)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: For patient records we need a 7-year retention window for clinical intake logs (per regulator). Analytics logs can be 1 year.
- PHI: Initially we will send identifiable PHI for the POC; long-term we want an option to tokenize before sending, but for model accuracy evaluation we will likely need raw fields during training/validation steps.
- Logging / Audit: We require immutable audit logs ingestible by our Splunk instance (SIEM). We also need clear retention and purge controls for logs.
- DPA: We will require a DPA and want to see SOC2 Type II or equivalent artifacts. Can you also share any HIPAA posture notes?

Questions:
1) Can Redwood provide a data flow diagram showing where PHI is stored/transient and where logs are retained?
2) Is customer-managed key (KMS) support available in Hosted mode or only in Private?

Dr. Shah (copied) will be the clinical/ops approver; loop in legal (I'll introduce them pending your MAP update).

--
Michael Liu
Head of Security & Compliance
MedFolio Health
michael.liu@medfolio.com | +1 212-555-0188

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Liu <michael.liu@medfolio.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dr. Priya Shah <priya.shah@medfolio.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestones (MedFolio)

Thanks Michael — this is helpful. I updated the MAP draft and attached a SOC2 snapshot (Redwood-SOC2-snapshot-2026Q1.pdf). Key updates below and proposed owners/ETA: 

MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (updated)- Target close date: 2026-06-30
- Redwood deliverables:
  • SOC2 Type II evidence snapshot (Rafael) — ETA 2026-05-21
  • Data flow diagram & storage map (Product Security) — ETA 2026-05-18
  • Logging & audit plan (engineering + security) — includes Splunk ingestion options & retention controls — ETA 2026-05-25
  • DPA + standard security annex (Legal) — draft provided for review — ETA dependent on MedFolio legal feedback
- MedFolio deliverables:
  • Confirm retention periods (7 years clinical intake, 1 year analytics logs) — Michael / Legal
  • Confirm whether PHI will be tokenized for production or sent to Redwood (POC will include PHI) — Dr. Shah
  • Provide legal contact for DPA review
- Dependencies:
  • KMS integration: if MedFolio requires customer-managed keys for production, we’ll need an integration window and key rotation plan. Hosted supports provider-managed KMS today; customer-managed KMS is available for Private and can be scoped for Dedicated.
  • Legal sign-off on DPA & security annex

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to update HubSpot MAP record and share link (done).
- Short technical sync between Rafael + MedFolio infra (request for Splunk endpoint and SIEM schema). Rafael — can you propose 2 times next week?
- MedFolio to confirm retention & legal contact by EOD 2026-05-18 so we can keep the MAP on track.

Attached: updated MAP draft and SOC2 snapshot. Let me know if you want a joint call with legal/security this week.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-snapshot-2026Q1.pdf; MedFolio-Redwood-MAP-draft-v2.pdf
